verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise patibrataa par purakhai na dhekhio chaahai pooran patibrataa kai pat hee kai dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a faithful wife does not like to look at another man and being sincere and faithful always supports her husband in her mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਆਸ ਘਨ-ਬੂੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sar saritaa samu(n)dhr chaatirak na chaahai kaahoo aas ghana-boo(n)dh pria pria gun giaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a rain-bird does not want water from a lake river or sea, but keeps on wailing for Swati drop from the clouds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਕਰ ਓਰ ਭੋਰ ਚਾਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਚਕੋਰ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਿਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhinakar or bhor chaahat nahee chakor man bach kram himakar pria praan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a Ruddy sheldrake does not like to look at the Sun even when the Sun is rising because the moon is his beloved in all respects.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਰਹਤਿ ਪੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਨ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh aan dhev sev rahat pai sahaj subhaav na avagiaa abhimaan hai ||466||

en.bdb: So is a devoted disciple of the True Guru who does not worship any other god or goddess except the dearer than his life-True Guru. But, by remaining in a state of tranquility, he neither disrespects anyone nor shows the arrogance of his supremacy.  (466)
